satellites.title: Changing with Circumstance
satellites.evidence: 變通 names adapting a method to circumstances. The everyday compound is not itself the Yijing metaphysics of change.

satellites.title: At the Limit, Change
satellites.evidence: Xici, part two: 易窮則變，變則通，通則久 — “when change reaches its limit it alters; altering, it gets through; getting through, it lasts.” The everyday 變通 on this card comes from this chain.
